# grounded-copy for dsh

Help AI say clearly and get to the point.

This package gives DeepSeek Harness (dsh) the grounded-copy writing rules for every reply, the grounded-copy skill, and a `/grounded` command for the writing mode.

## Install

Run:

    dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:HiroHyun/grounded-copy

Use the profile you start dsh with, then restart dsh. From a clone of the repository, add `./dist/dsh/grounded-copy` in place of the GitHub name.

## Writing mode

Type `/grounded` to see the current mode. Choose `/grounded chat` for everyday interaction and ordinary documents, `/grounded copy` for product pages and marketing copy, or `/grounded off` to turn the rules off. The next reply follows your choice, and it stays saved after a restart.

The setting lives at `$DSH_HOME/grounded-copy/profile`, or `~/.dsh/grounded-copy/profile` by default.

Read the [setup guide](skills/grounded-copy/references/setup.md) for details and the [pattern guide](skills/grounded-copy/references/patterns.md) for examples.

## Package maintenance

This directory is generated by `scripts/build_dsh_adapter.py` in the repository. Edit the source files there, run the builder, and commit the generated files. The builder's `--check` option reports differences, missing files, and unexpected files.
